title.narrative: Extension of the multi-purpose reception centre at Lipa

description.narrative: Contract related to: Extension of the multi-purpose reception centre at Lipa - This Action is designed to respond to the most urgent needs such as food, accommodation, medical assistance and access to education and social protection. The Action will contribute to further upgrade reception centres. Special attention will be put on the specific needs of vulnerable groups.The Action also aims at enhancing social cohesion, improving the resilience of local communities. Finally, the Action will strengthen border and migration control capabilities, returns, in line with fundamental rights.
